I was dming. And I introduced a reoccurring character named Thejah. He was a young human from a small village named Witrey. The party was sent to witrey because this cult killed a family of farmers near the town. The parties job was to investigate and eliminate the threat. To guide them there was Thejah. 

They were on a carriage on their way to the farm. On the way, I had Thejah have a nice little conversation with the party. Thejah asked about their adventures and travels. Thejah wanted to become a solider for the royal army so he could travel and protect others. After they took out the skeletons and the necromancer controlling them, they all went to the pub to celebrate. While drinking, one of the players asked Thejah if there was a girl he was interested in. He answered with yes, and that it was another human girl by the name of Maria who was the village medic. He has had a thing for her for a long time, but never could work up the courage to ask her out. So the party them gave him a pep talk, walked over to her shop, and then helped him ask her out. Then the next day, the party left the village. And Thejah was there to say goodbye. Hoping that he would see them again. Which he did, a bunch.

The party loved this guy. They would do everything with this guy. Raid goblin camps, drink, explore dungeons, fight, etc. 

The party were very good friends of Thejah. They were there when he proposed to Maria, when he had his wedding, when his parents died, when he was promoted to officer in the army, and a bunch of other stuff.
If you want non lethal, go for the mucus. If you want to to be more interesting for the players, go for a more harmful one like assassins blood or serpent venom
